reasons: Red: AI basket drawdown / momentum, Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.84% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +7bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.4pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 140 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 96 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 18.0 sits at the 61th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 12.4, so implied carries +5.6 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nvidia's 5-year CDS hits a record high as it weighs a $250B backstop for OpenAI's SoftBank-Ohio data center lease, on top of a possible $350B chip-financing deal
items.note: Credit markets are pricing rising leverage risk in Nvidia's expanding circular-financing web (SoftBank, OpenAI, SK Group), a concrete stress signal distinct from Nvidia's still-buoyant stock.

items.headline: CoreWeave's 5-year CDS blows out to ~855bps, implying roughly 50% five-year default odds, even as it sweetens pricing on a $2.6B loan tied to Anthropic/Jane Street/Hudson River Trading capacity
items.note: A junk-rated neocloud having to widen loan pricing to clear a deal, while its CDS market implies coin-flip default odds, is a direct read on deteriorating AI-debt appetite rather than commentary.

items.headline: Meta's free cash flow collapses 91% YoY to $784M as AI capex consumes 98% of operating cash flow; shares fall on a disappointing revenue outlook and narrowed capex range
items.note: Near-total consumption of operating cash by AI capex is a credit-relevant cash-generation signal that raises the odds Meta leans further on debt to fund its build-out.

items.headline: Moody's warns AI capex could threaten credit quality at Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Oracle and CoreWeave as they shift from asset-light to asset-heavy balance sheets
items.note: A ratings agency putting the credit-quality risk of the AI buildout on the record, across nearly every major name in the trade, is a notable escalation beyond routine analyst color.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
